results.title: Me ya sa 'yan Syria ke ƙara talaucewa tun bayan faɗuwar gwamnatin Assad?

results.title: Ko wutar lantarkin Najeriya ta bunƙasa a lokacin Tinubu?

results.title: Shin AI na riƙe sirrinku?
results.content: Sayar da bayanan masu amfani lokacin da kamfani ya durƙushe ba sabon abu ba ne, amma AI ya ƙara girman wannan haɗarin.

results.title: Ta yaya za a warware rikicin siyasar Isra'ila? Ga wasu yanayi guda huɗu
results.content: Da aka ƙidaya sama da kashi 90% na ƙuri'un, dukkan alamu sun nuna cewa akwai matsala. Mafi yuwuwar sakamakon zai iya zama sabbin zaɓe.

results.title: Me ya sa INEC ta ƙi sanya Aminu Abdulsalam a jerin ƴantakarar gwamnan Kano?
results.content: Ana ci gaba da tafka muhawara kan rashin ganin sunan ɗan takarar jam'iyyar NDC a zaɓen gwamnan jihar Kano, Kwamrade Aminu Abdulsalam Gwarzo wanda hukumar INEC ta fitar.

results.title: Shin AI barazana ne ga ayyukan mata?
results.content: Ta yaya basirar wucin gadi ke tasiri kan damar da mata ke da ita a kasuwar aiki? Tsoron ganin wasu ayyukan yi sun ɓace na tafiya kafada da kafada da bullowar sabbin damarmaki; ta hanyar horo da kuma ƙwarewar fasahar dijital, mata na iya cin gajiyar waɗannan sauye-sauye.

results.title: Yadda goyon bayan Amurka ga Isra'ila ya zama abin tayar da hankali a zaɓe
results.content: Damuwa kan goyon bayan da Amurka ke bai wa Isra'ila yanzu haka yana kara wa masu kada kuri'a kwarin gwiwa a bangarorin biyu na wannan batu, a daya daga cikin zabukan da suka fi samun karbuwa a zaben tsakiyar wa'adi na Amurka.

results.title: 'Yan uwan da aka zubar a jaka suna jarirai sun sake haɗuwa bayan shekaru

results.title: Me ya rage wa Najeriya wajen kafa ƴansandan jihohi?

results.title: Munanan haɗurran jiragen ƙasa 7 da suka fi girgiza duniya
results.content: Lokacin da ka hau jirgin ƙasa, abin da kake fata shi ne ka isa inda za ka cikin ƙoshin lafiya. Wataƙila ka jingina a kujerarka kana kallon kyawawan abubuwan da ke wucewa ta taga, ko kuma kana gudanar da harkokinka, ba tare da tunanin cewa tafiyar na iya rikidewa zuwa bala'i cikin daƙiƙu kaɗan ba.
